patch_description: The best prior program (combined_score 0.14, gpu 0.76, expert 0.29) had two improvements over the current code that were lost: (1) a local-search swap refinement inside `balanced_packing` that iteratively swaps items between the heaviest and lightest packs to reduce maximum pack weight, and (2) in `rebalance_experts`, computing both the global policy and the hierarchical policy and picking whichever yields lower per-GPU load imbalance (sum of squared deviations from the mean GPU load). The current code has neither, and scores worse (0.66 gpu, 0.25 expert). I restore both edits — they measurably improve balancedness while keeping the algorithm fast (times_algorithm was 0.07s vs 0.01s, still negligible). The local-search swap only ever trades members between the max and min packs and requires both resulting packs to be lighter than the old max, so it strictly improves GPU-level balance at both Step 1 (groups→nodes) and Step 3 (physical experts→GPUs). The policy selection guards against cases where the hierarchical policy's node partitioning hurts global GPU balance.
